description: This is a shell script to generate cryptographic keys and self-sign certificates using certtool, tailored for setting up a local Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) with various key types and signing procedures.

methods.name: gen_rsa_key
methods.description: Generates an RSA key pair and saves private and public key files.

methods.name: gen_ecc_key
methods.description: Generates an ECC key pair and saves private and public key files.

methods.name: gen_key
methods.description: Selects key generation type based on KEY_TYPE variable and calls the appropriate function.

methods.name: ca_sign_self
methods.description: Creates a self-signed certificate for the CA.

methods.name: ca_sign
methods.description: Signs a CSR or certificate request with a CA certificate and key to produce an end-entity certificate.
